artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated against a cross, holding it to his chest. He has long hair, a beard, and a contemplative expression. He wears a robe and rests his bare feet on the ground, with a skull in his lap. The background includes trees and a fallen log, with a glowing effect around the man's head.

artworks.title: Deliberation (Beratung)
artworks.description: The image shows angular lines and sharp geometric shapes, forming three humanoid figures. The figures seem to be conversing, with exaggerated limbs and facial outlines creating a sense of movement. The woodcut print technique adds texture and depth to the stark black and white contrast of the composition.

artworks.title: Allegory of Fortune
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a winged figure holding a cherub next to a horse and a person in armor. The artwork portrays a detailed scene with mythological and allegorical elements. The winged figure embraces the cherub, who reaches towards them, as they stand beside a horse. The person in armor interacts with the horse. The background shows a stacked block wall. The intricate details, such as feathers, clothing folds, and horse anatomy, are depicted with fine lines and shading. The text at the bottom reads: "Io son fortuna buona, ho mecco Amore, Se mi conosci, ti farò signore." The artwork's composition and style suggest influences from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers
artworks.description: This drawing depicts classical architecture and figures in an elaborate scene. The image shows a group of figures gathered around a central character in a grand setting with tall fluted columns, classical sculptures, objects, and animals. Relief sculptures, arches, and decorative elements enhance the atmosphere. The image is dense with figures and ornate details.

artworks.title: Semiramis on the Lion Hunt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession or caravan-like scene set in a lush landscape. The image depicts an assembly of camels and horses surrounded by vegetation, with several people leading and accompanying the animals. There are intricate details in the foliage of the trees and in the rocky terrain. At the foreground rests a pair of lions. The background features distant mountains beneath a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 1 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a procession in front of a grand architectural setting. There is a central structure, potentially a ceremonial gate, with intricate designs such as arches and columns. There are mounted figures in elaborate costumes and soldiers marching in formation. The scene is detailed with fine linework, capturing textures and patterns clearly. It is monochromatic, enhancing the contrast between elements and highlighting architectural and figure details.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 2 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men on horseback in a formation. They are in profile view, with a leader on the left and followers to the right. The leader is calmly seated on his horse, wearing a cloak and a wide-brimmed hat. He has distinct facial features with a mustache and a serious expression. The followers are similarly dressed with hats, cloaks, and boots. Some horses are rearing up, while others are marching beside their riders. One follower is holding a long rod. In the background, distant structures like windmills can be seen under a blank sky. The foreground is a flat landscape with small vegetation.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 3 of 6]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horse riders in elaborate attire. The riders are mounted on horses and are dressed in detailed embellishments. The horses are depicted with precision, appearing to be trotting or standing elegantly. The background is minimal, allowing the focus to remain on the intricate portrayal of the horses and riders. Lines and shading emphasize the movement and posture of both riders and horses.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 4 of 6]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted riders in elaborate attire. The artwork features detailed depictions of horses and riders, with line work and shading. The riders are dressed in period clothing with ornate hats and garments. The horses are shown in various stances, conveying movement. The background is minimalistic with cloud formations and a vast sky. Detailed line work is used to highlight designs on the attire and the musculature of the horses.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 5 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of horses standing together. The horses are detailed with elaborate saddles and bridles, and the backdrop is a sky defined by delicate lines and minimalistic clouds. The detailed line work emphasizes texture and form, particularly in depicting the manes of the horses and the fabric of the clothing.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 6 of 6]
artworks.description: This is an etching drawing of a scene with a horse-drawn carriage, mounted riders, and a group of people and a dog. The image portrays a group traveling scene, with a carriage on the left that holds a woman under a canopy. Several individuals are mounted on horses, while others stand or walk beside them. To the right, more people gather, seemingly positioned in a group discussion or meeting. In the foreground, a dog appears to be leading or inspecting the way. The use of line work and cross-hatching suggests detailed texture in the clothing and the animals, providing a sense of depth and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 6 of 6]
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of riders on horseback. The image shows riders wearing elaborate outfits, with large plumed hats, all mounted on horses. They are arranged in a procession across the composition. The background is primarily a lightly textured sky, with a suggestion of clouds. The horses are depicted with a sense of movement and the scene is rendered in detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Poet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated on a rocky surface in a contemplative pose with their elbow resting on a raised surface, possibly a stone or ledge, and their hand supporting their chin. The figure has a head adorned with a laurel wreath, and their facial features are accentuated by deep shadows, giving the impression of a thoughtful expression. The person is wearing flowing, draped clothing that covers their entire body and cascades to the ground. In the background, there is a tree with a thick trunk and sparse leaves, alongside uneven rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Au Jardin des Plantes
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an elephant using its trunk to take a hat from a person through vertical bars. The person is surprised by the elephant's action.

artworks.title: Un Parasol dans une position difficile
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing depicting two groups labeled "Espagne" and "France" advancing towards each other. In the middle stands a figure holding an umbrella, wearing elaborate clothing including a cape with tassels. The scene shows the groups moving in opposite directions, with the figure seemingly caught between them. The use of shading emphasizes the contrast between the stationary figure and the moving groups, creating a tense and complex scene.

artworks.title: Actualités: Mme. Potard - N'est-il pas vrai, brave turco...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of a group of people seated together, filling the frame from the waist up to their heads. The central figure is a man wearing a light-colored cap, with discernible facial features including wide eyes and a large smile. His attire consists of a long-sleeve shirt. On either side of him, there are men and women who are dressed in formal 19th-century clothing, including top hats and shawls, with some women wearing bonnets. The group is seated in what appears to be a carriage or salon, indicated by the narrow windows in the background. Outside the windows, a faint outline of a cityscape can be seen, consisting of buildings and faint human figures in the distance. The scene is framed by a border with the title "ACTUALITÉS" at the top and dialogue at the bottom.

artworks.title: Aspect d'une gare de chemin de fer...
artworks.description: The image shows a busy scene outside a train station. Many people are crowded together, some trying to board or exit. They are depicted in motion, with exaggerated facial features and various body positions. Men are wearing suits and top hats, women are in dresses with bonnets. One man is shown sitting above the chaos on a ledge, holding a long stick or whip. There is no jewelry visible, but hats, walking canes, and packages can be seen. A clock on the wall indicates a busy moment. The station has grand architecture.

artworks.title: Il faut que vous fassiez encore place...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded train. The drawing shows passengers squished and contorted against each other, depicting a sense of overcrowding. The figures have exaggerated expressions. One person is trying to organize the crowd. The title at the top reads "LES TRAINS DE PLAISIR."

artworks.title: Un Train de plaisir un peu trop gai
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside a train compartment. The figures are depicted with exaggerated expressions and gestures, capturing a chaotic atmosphere. The passengers appear to be enjoying a celebration, with bottles and objects in motion, suggesting revelry. The artist uses strong, flowing lines and a monochrome palette to create movement and energy in the scene. The title is "Un train de plaisir un peu trop gai".

artworks.title: Parisiens regrettant vivement...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of people in formal attire on an open train carriage during a rainy journey. The passengers are huddled together, seeking shelter from heavy rain indicated by diagonal lines. They are wearing top hats, which are not suitable for the stormy weather. The background shows a blurred landscape, emphasizing the focus on the struggle against the elements. The composition humorously juxtaposes the stylish appearance of the travelers with the inconvenience of rain, hinting at a critique of societal norms and class expectations.

artworks.title: L'Inconvénient d'être dans un wagon...
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing of a group of people on a train. The drawing shows a crowded train compartment filled with animated individuals. They display exaggerated expressions, with one person appearing to be speaking loudly. The caricature style emphasizes facial expressions and gestures, capturing a chaotic and humorous scene. The image is framed with a decorative border and features text related to sharing a train compartment with overly inebriated passengers.

artworks.title: Un Train de plaisir
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seated passengers closely packed in what seems to be a train carriage. The individuals are sitting shoulder to shoulder on a long bench, with some leaning against each other or forward slightly. Their facial expressions are exaggerated, showing various features such as tiredness or weariness. They have various hairstyles and wear a mix of clothing from what looks like early 19th-century attire. One person has a satchel slung over their shoulder. The background indicates the inside of a carriage with curved walls and a window source of light in the distance.

artworks.title: Invasion de Paris par les Bas-Normands
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with people in unusual attire. The drawing presents a scene depicting a group of figures walking in a procession, each adorned with exaggerated headgear and facial expressions. One figure has a fan-shaped headpiece, while another wears a puppet-like hat. The attire of the characters evokes a sense of parody and is drawn with caricatured features, emphasizing humor and exaggeration. The background shows more figures dressed in similar outlandish fashions, contributing to the comedic and surreal atmosphere of the scene. The drawing is in a monochromatic, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Au Havre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of travelers waiting indoors while it rains outside. The drawing features several individuals seated and standing in a waiting area. To the left, people are sitting on benches. A figure in a tall hat stands in the center, gazing out through a window. Outside, rain is pouring down, and a person holding an umbrella struggles against the strong wind. The style is illustrative, capturing the dreariness of being stuck indoors during inclement weather. This drawing employs strong lines and shading to convey the somber atmosphere and the wet, blustery conditions outside.
